processOwnership.historicalEvidence: Missing processOwnership is historical-only and never attests shared-runtime execution.

core.identity: full candidate and authority Git commit revisions
core.sourceBinding: canonical HTTPS SourceRepository and equivalent single local origin URL
core.candidateInventory: regular files in the pinned Git tree, byte hashes, exact index path and mode set
core.untrackedPolicy: reject non-ignored untracked source files; ignored and untracked private files are never inventoried or copied
core.developmentContent: AllowDevelopmentContent permits only modified tracked bytes and always remains release-ineligible
core.snapshot: run-owned copy of verified tracked regular files only; no .git directory or untracked content
core.skillDiscovery: discover and compare active Skills only inside the verified tracked-only snapshot
core.checks: execute every unique declared local general or Pester check against the snapshot with bounded output, timeout, and owned cleanup
core.legacyCapabilities: no supervisor binding, resolver receipt, external scanner, provider, approval, publish, install, or ten-stage lifecycle prerequisite
core.filesystemIsolation: same-account child processes do not have filesystem read isolation; execute untrusted candidates only in platform-provided no-secret low-privilege pull-request environments
core.localFixture: local smoke tests use only trusted isolated fixtures

modes.ordinary: no CompleteLifecycle or DevelopmentHarness switch; requires adapter v2 and rejects adapter v1 before legacy gates
modes.legacyAdvanced: adapter v1 requires explicit CompleteLifecycle; signed supervisor binding remains mandatory
modes.legacyDevelopmentHarness: adapter v1 may use explicit DevelopmentHarness for local regression only; output remains unverified and release-ineligible
modes.versionMixing: adapter v2 with either legacy mode switch is invalid

sourceValidation.selection: Explicit -SourceValidation with core v2 adapter.sourceValidation and RunId; absent extension rejects this mode; ordinary Core rejects extension and never dispatches source tools.
sourceValidation.setup: Existing approved-source resolver acquires only during explicit setup, freezes three actual tool receipts and full installed closure; source execution never downloads or changes source.
sourceValidation.skillToolsFreeze: Freeze the executed Node runtime and entry-point payload with exact hashes. Bind the npm launcher shim to that payload, runtime and installed closure through launcher integrity; launcher-shim membership in frozenFiles is not required.
sourceValidation.binding: One immutable candidate, authority, adapter, fresh run and raw process output; duplicate/empty/partial inventory, changed identity, invalid parse, failure, timeout or cleanup failure never passes. Platform-unavailable requires a runner-owned native compatibility probe bound to the frozen command/arguments digest, verified tool/runtime receipt identity and same-event process result. Missing observations block. Probe execution never implies scanner PASS, scan execution, complete coverage or release eligibility.
sourceValidation.semantic: Source checks cover stages 1–5 only; no provider, consent, signer, key or release prerequisite. Existing explicit Semantic and full lifecycle retain their own contract.
sourceValidation.requiredCheckGate: Assert-StandardCoreSourceCheckReport; Core-only PASS never qualifies. Same-workflow projection only; no release/install/publish authorization.
sourceValidation.testOwnership: Omitted: complete unfiltered candidate tests tree. Explicit central-third-party-raw-skill-v1: successful candidate-bound raw package evidence, complete fixed central raw suite, same immutable authority revision and frozen files, separately bound testSourceIdentity; no caller-defined root or test filter. Both modes require the complete actual discovery/execution union and zero unpassed cases.
